relationships.evidence_quote: including the anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) fremanezumab and galcanezumab

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Fremanezumab and galcanezumab were rated very-to-extremely effective for reducing migraine days by roughly two-thirds of respondents

key_findings: Survey of 21 Brazilian headache specialists: anti-CGRP mAbs (fremanezumab, galcanezumab) perceived as effective and well tolerated in chronic migraine, including with MOH.
Cost was the main barrier (90.5%); most favored earlier positioning of mAbs.
